doc: Alternating columns of s = +6 (shield saturated at 1) and -6 (shield 0 and cumulus 0: u below -1.6) with the sub-texel noise and an array streak <= -1 present: the coverage is exactly 1 and exactly 0 (the binomial term vanishes where the cumulus fraction is 0). Exact mode: every texel is 1 + 0 x c or 0 + 1 x 0, so any IEEE implementation returns exactly those floats. Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype.
